subject.title: [Bug]: keyless WebIQ search disables secrets runtime fast path

question: Should the secrets fast path recognize the proposed credential-free host-proxy shape after the linked PR is narrowed to the secrets change?
rationale: The optimization intentionally bypasses full resolver preparation, so maintainers must confirm that the proposed provider/plugin checks preserve the fail-closed secrets boundary.

options.title: Narrow and review the guard
options.body: Remove unrelated autoreview changes, retain the positive and fail-closed test matrix, and have the secrets owners review the focused fast-path exception.

options.title: Keep the resolver path
options.body: Reject the optimization and continue using full secret preparation for every configured web-search surface.

options.title: Accept the combined scope
options.body: Review both the secrets optimization and autoreview behavior change together, accepting the larger and less cohesive merge surface.

recommendation.title: Narrow and review the guard
recommendation.body: Remove unrelated autoreview changes, retain the positive and fail-closed test matrix, and have the secrets owners review the focused fast-path exception.

likelyOwner.reason: This group is the explicit CODEOWNERS assignee for the affected secrets runtime files.
